connect_step1: 1. Put the TV and this device on the same Wi-Fi.
connect_step2: 2. Open the TV's web browser and go to:
connect_step3: 3. The TV will show a pairing code. Scan it with this device, or type it below.
connect_qr_hint: Using a tablet or laptop as the screen? Scan this code with it instead of typing the address.
other_addresses: If that address doesn't open, try one of these:
tv_connected_scan: A TV is connected and showing a code.
scan_hint: Point the camera at the QR code on the TV.
pair_without_code: Pair this TV without the code
pairing_failed: That code doesn't match the one on the TV. Try again.
no_tv_connected: No TV connected. Players can still join on their phones.
no_camera: No camera found on this device. Type the code instead.
mode_spoken_desc: Like the TV show: you read the question, the player answers out loud, you tap Correct or Wrong.
mode_choices4_desc: The player whose turn it is picks one of four answers on their phone.
mode_letters_desc: Four options, but only their first letters are shown - you either know it or you don't.
mode_choices2_desc: Two answers to choose from. Good for younger players.
categories_hint: {n} questions available in the selected categories.
show_question_tv_on: Questions shown on the TV: On
show_question_tv_off: Questions shown on the TV: Off
content_repo_hint: Rules, questions and translations are read from this public GitHub repository every time the app starts.
double_note: Everything banked this round is multiplied by {x}!
change_starter_hint: Tap a name to change who starts this round.
no_questions: No questions available - check the content repository.
options_hint: Options on the player's phone (the highlighted one is correct). Tap one to answer for them.
tap_again_to_end: Tap again to end the game
go_to_h2h: Go to the Head to Head
voting_hint: Players vote on their phones. For a player without a phone, tap 'Vote for them' and enter their choice.
tie_hint: {name}, as the Chain Champion, you have the casting vote.
token_line: {name} takes a Chain Breaker token ({n} so far)
h2h_intro: {a} and {b} go head to head for {bank}
h2h_rules: {n} questions each. Most correct answers wins; if it's level, sudden death.
order_hint: {name}, as the Chain Champion: go first or second?
sudden_death_hint: Sudden death: the first to answer wrong when the other is right loses.
err_too_few_players: Not enough players for this format.
err_too_many_players: Too many players for this format.
tv_enable_sound: Press OK / click once to turn the sound on
tv_pair_hint: On the host device, tap 'Scan the TV's QR code' and point it here - or type the code.
tv_no_players: Scan the code to join the game
tv_vote_hint: Vote on your phone - in secret.
ph_wait_host: Waiting for the host to start. Watch the TV.
ph_watch_tv: Watch the TV - you can join the next game.
ph_vote_hint: Who is the Chain Breaker? You can change your vote until the host reveals them.
ph_you_decide: You're the Chain Champion - you decide who goes.
ph_token_you: You take a Chain Breaker token!
ph_choose_order: You're the Chain Champion. Do you want to go first or second?
media_failed: The picture couldn't be loaded here (it may still show on the TV).
media_image_note: This picture is showing on the TV.
media_clip_note: The clip is playing on the TV.
replay_clip: Replay the clip on the TV
rules_hint: Changes apply to {format} and are saved on this device. Anything you don't change still comes from the content repository.
rule_type_elimination_desc: The Chain Breaker leaves after every vote until two players remain.
rule_type_tokens_desc: The Chain Breaker gets a token each round; the two with the fewest tokens play the final.
rule_rounds_follow: With a full game that is {n} rounds (one per player voted off).
rule_final_round: Extra round for the last two
rule_no_sudden_death_note: Without sudden death, a tie goes to the player who answered first.
sum_h2h_sd: {n} head-to-head questions each, then sudden death
join_qr_hint: Players scan this code with their phone camera (same Wi-Fi as this device), type their name and tap Join. Add anyone without a phone below.
join_qr_hint_tv: The same code is on the TV. Players on the same Wi-Fi scan it, type their name and tap Join.
join_status: Phones connected: {n} · join page opened {m} times
join_trouble: Phone shows an error page or nothing? Check it is on the same Wi-Fi as this device (not mobile data or a guest network). When testing in the Unity editor on a PC, allow Unity Editor through Windows Firewall for private networks. If the address above doesn't open, try one of these:
ph_claim_title_lobby: Already added by the host? Tap your name
ph_claim_title_game: Playing in this game? Tap your name
ph_claim_hint: Your phone becomes that player's buttons: bank, answer and vote.
